formatter.title: Formatter
formatter.description: Specify the formatting ruleset for your code.

eol.title: End-of-line
eol.description: Indicate whether we use the new line character ("lf", recommended) or Windows-style carriage-return-new-line ("crlf").

tabWidth.title: Tab Width
tabWidth.description: Number of spaces to use for indentation.

hangingIndent.title: Hanging Indent
hangingIndent.description:
Do we use hanging indentation for multi-line statements?

For multi-line statements this means that the first line begins at the standard indentation level and all subsequent lines are indented further to align with a syntactic element (e.g., after an opening parenthesis), rather than using a uniform block indent.

This affect routine names, function calls, procedure calls, arrays, structures, and parentheses.

autoDoc.title: AutoDoc
autoDoc.description: Automatically creates and updates IDL Doc style comments for routines on each save. You can freely use this if you don't have docs for your code. If you have docs, and they don't follow IDL Doc style, they are preserved.

autoFix.title: Auto-fix Problems
autoFix.description: If a problem can be automatically fixed, fix it prior to formatting. This does not apply to all problems detected by IDL.

styleAndFormat.title: No Style or Formatting
styleAndFormat.description:
When we process our code, do we apply our styles and format?

If this is set to `false` and `autoDoc` is enabled, then we add documentation to your code without changing anything else.

maxIndent.title: Max Indent
maxIndent.description: Maximum indent size (number of spaces) that we will insert when auto-indenting your code during formatting

description: Top-level preferences for how code gets formatted.

quotes.title: Quote Formatting
quotes.description: For string literals what type of quote we use. Includes numbers defined using quotes.

methods.title: Method Formatting
methods.description: Do we use a dot or arrow for method invocation

keywords.title: Keyword Formatting
keywords.description: Formatting for keywords, includes binary keywords

properties.title: Property Formatting
properties.description: Controls the case style of properties

control.title: Control Formatting
control.description: How are control statements, such as "for", "if", "pro", formatted

numbers.title: Number Formatting
numbers.description: Controls accents to letters that set the data type and their case

hex.title: Hex Number Formatting
hex.description: Indicates formatting for hexadecimal (hex) numbers (either defined with quotes or "0x")

octal.title: Octal Number Formatting
octal.description: Indicates formatting for octal numbers (either defined with quotes or "0o")

binary.title: Binary Number Formatting
binary.description: Indicates formatting for binary numbers (either defined with quotes or "0b")

routines.title: Routine Formatting
routines.description: When we encounter a known routine (functions and procedures), how do we format it with respect to the definition

routineMethods.title: Routine Method Formatting
routineMethods.description: When we encounter a known routine method (function methods and procedure methods), how do we format it with respect to the definition?

structureNames.title: Structure Name Formatting
structureNames.description: When we have a known named structure, how do we format the name?

localVariables.title: Local Variable Formatting
localVariables.description: If local variables match the case for the first instance that we find

1.0.0-options.description: This controls how code is automatically formatted when using the buttons in the sidebar or formatting on save.
